course_name_original: PROGRAMMAZIONE A OGGETTI E INGEGNERIA DEL SOFTWARE
prerequisites: Knowledge and skills in basic programming acquired during previous years' courses.

learning_outcomes.text: Introduce the object-oriented paradigm and conceptual modeling as tools in all phases of software development, from analysis to design and implementation of applications.
Introduce and analyze the main issues related to the design and development of medium and large-sized software.

Provide advanced skills in software design and development, with particular reference to requirements analysis, identification and application of design patterns, and verification and validation techniques.

Acquire the necessary knowledge to develop software in Java according to the object-oriented programming paradigm, with mentions of the latest methodologies and tools for software development based on Artificial Intelligence techniques.

assessment_methods.method: Presentation of a group software project in Java
Discussion of topics covered in class (individual oral exam)

assessment_rules: The evaluation consists of the presentation of a group software project in Java and the discussion of topics covered in class. A positive evaluation of the project is necessary to access the individual oral exam.

Ian Sommerville Ingegneria del software. PEARSON
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Elettronica E Informatica (Electronic And Computer Engineering), classe L-8 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria dell'informazione
